title: 第14章 探索东院
content_zh:
第14章探索东院
蜡烛、雕塑、尸骸，以及古香古色的格子门，门外是荒草起伏的庭院，倾倒的青铜香炉，还有青石板路和皎洁的月光。
死寂中透着荒凉和诡异。
“这地方似乎永远处于黑夜。”
张元清抬起手掌凑到嘴边，吐出了含在嘴里的蓝色小药丸。
法子成功了，我真特么机智他欣喜的把药丸放兜里，对自己的“前途”稍稍有了些信心。
有了它们，在面对红舞鞋时，就有了保命的希望。
接着，他劲直走到贡品桌前，思考片刻，伸手握住了烛台。
陡然间，一条信息于眼前浮现：
【名称：永不熄灭的蜡烛】
【类型：燃料】
【功能：镇邪、净化】
【介绍：三道山娘娘留下的道具，据说是长明兽的油脂提炼而成，具有镇邪、净化的功效。】
【备注：有时候，净化恐惧未必是好事。另外，它无法被挪动。】
果然，道具只有亲手触摸，才能得到信息。而之前没敢碰蜡烛，所以一直不知道这是件道具，直到看了资料
“净化恐惧未必是好事，按照关雅说的分类，蜡烛是代价类，使用它的代价是失去恐惧。但我现在很害怕，完全没有作死的想法，先苟在主殿吧。”
他在贡品桌前盘坐，思考着接下来的行动。
“接下来的行动目标是探索东边的院子，摸索出那里潜藏的危险和规律，再寻找克制、克服的办法。探索时间不能超过15分钟，否则怨灵趴肩，必死无疑。”
“蓝色药丸是我对付红舞鞋的底牌，但未必管用，而一旦直面红舞鞋，不是生就是死.先探索东院吧，对那边的环境做一个初步的了解，再思考应对之策。”
事到临头，他心里仍有几分畏惧、退缩，不想外出。上次活下来是侥幸，这一次能不能活还是个未知数。

东院那边情况不明，无法判断凶险程度，很容易试试就逝世。
但是，这世上的事，从来不是你不想，就可以不用。
虽然探索古庙的任务没有时间限制，理论上他可以一直苟在主殿，可没有时限也就意味着，不完成任务，他多半永远都出不去。
拖的久了，身体会因为饥饿、困倦、口渴等原因，状态下滑。
到时候再出去探索，那就是死路一条了。
“伸头缩头都是一刀，只能拼了！”
张元清咬咬牙，大步朝外行去。
等等，我应该再考虑考虑，外面很危险一只脚踏出门槛的他，突然打起退堂鼓，忍不住回头看一眼殿内，留恋此地的光辉。
烛光温暖，驱散阴霾，净化污秽，带给人内心无与伦比的勇气和自信。
问题不大张元清自信满满的出门。
月光皎皎如霜，张元清沿着主殿左侧，踩着鹅软石小径，重新来到荒凉破败的四合院。
没有虫鸣和鸟叫的夜晚，寂静的让人害怕。
但寂静也让人心安，他最怕出门听见“哒哒”的脚步声。
“十五分钟，我只有十五分钟的时间，要赶在怨灵缠身之前探索完东院.”
他进入四合院最东边的房间，从靠在窗下的尸骸身上，重新摸索出铜镜，藏进兜里。
然后小心翼翼的穿过拱形门，进入东院。
东院比四合院要大很多，映入眼中的是一片荒废的园子，有假山、凉亭、小池，还有一棵大榕树，主干粗壮，枝干虬结，嫩绿的树叶反射着皎洁的月光。
榕树下有一口古井。
目光掠过假山凉亭，可以看见园子深处露出一字型的屋脊。
张元清没有直奔园子深处的建筑，而是谨慎的绕着大榕树走了一圈，资料里说这棵树很危险，但他绕了一圈后，没有发生任何意外。

“查看大榕树，应该也能推进探索度吧.”
张元清心里想着，撇了一眼黑黝黝的古井，犹豫再三，他还是没有勇气扑过去看一下。
他对这种恐怖故事里的古井，有很强的心理阴影。
张元清绕过了古井，窸窸窣窣的走在荒草间，朝着园子深处的建筑行去。
“咔嚓！”
突然，脚下发出脆响，吓的他原地蹦了起来。
定睛看去，原来是一具被荒草掩埋的尸体，裹着氧化的劳保服，张元清俯身检查，这具尸骸骨骼保存完好。
它是趴着倒地的，可头颅却是朝向身后，这说明死前被什么东西，把脑袋硬生生的拧了一百八十度。
什么东西干的？
张元清悄然警惕起来，起身，正要继续往前探索。
就在这时，一阵风刮了过来，园子里的荒草起伏不定，窸窣响动，身后那颗大榕树仿佛活了过来，有些扭曲的摇晃着枝叶。
“张元清，张元清”
身后传来一道尖细的叫声。
这声音随着风飘过来，仿佛是在耳畔低语，带来一阵阵毛骨悚然的寒意。
张元清出于本能，就要转身警戒，脑海里陡然闪过资料的信息：
不要回头！
“张元清，张元清”
见他没有反应，那声音似乎有些急切，想要让他赶紧转过头来。
张元清当然不会转身，他站在原地没动，悄悄拉开冲锋衣口袋拉链，摸出了黄铜镜，慢慢抬起，到达高过肩膀的位置。
黄铜镜把身后的景象，不太清晰的映照在了镜中。

古井里，钻出一个披头散发的白衣女人，她的脸上没有五官，正要那张惨白的肉脸，注视着张元清。
草你大爷张元清脸色一白，闷头就往前跑。
“张元清，张元清”
那声音一遍遍的呼唤，急切的呼唤，但只能无奈的看着他越跑越远。
很快，张元清绕过假山，来到园子深处，这里有一栋大屋，一字型屋脊，石块垒砌的地基，黄土砌成的墙体。
这边的屋子比四合院更加破旧，屋顶的瓦片稀稀落落，破了好多洞。
“资料里那位夜游神也来过这里，他只说不要回头，但没说不能往回走，井中女鬼的呼唤，或许只针对回头人。这样的话，我待会儿返回时，应该不会遭遇危险”
他原地深呼吸，平复了翻涌的恐惧和惊悚，把注意力集中在当前。
“先探索一下这栋屋子。”
这栋大屋总共有三扇门，代表着三间房。
他小心的靠拢最左边的一间，伸手用力推开破烂木门。
“吱呀～”
木门敞开的声音里，张元清连忙后退，摆出戒备姿态。
半晌，无事发生。
大着胆子进屋，月光从破烂的屋顶照射进来，他努力睁大眼睛，让瞳孔尽可能的收纳光线。
这里是厨房兼食堂，有两个青砖垒起的土灶，锅碗瓢盆水缸橱柜等物件，早已朽烂积灰。
没有危险，终于找到容器了张元清抓住一只灰扑扑的葫芦瓢，不由的发散思维：
“听说童子尿能破邪。”
他考虑要不要接一瓢童子尿，仔细思考后，无奈的放弃这个想法。
虽然没有交往过女孩子，但张元清觉得自己应该不能算童子。

“我太纵容你们了，给了你们一次又一次装逼的机会。”他低头凝视双手，有些痛心疾首。
经过一番探索，确认这座大屋是厨房和食堂的结合，没有任何特殊，也没有危险后，张元清拿着一把锈迹斑斑的菜刀，一根木棍，走出屋子，将目光投向最后那座长方形大屋。
与兼做大食堂的厨房不同，这栋屋子有四扇门，分割成四个房间。
张元清忍不住握紧手里的木棍和菜刀，它们未必有用，但能给人带来心里安慰。
他小心翼翼的检查了第一间和第二间屋子，它们属于杂物间，堆积着样式古老的农具、家具，以及募捐箱什么的。
没什么价值.张元清转而来到第三间屋子。
这是一间武器库，墙上挂着刀剑弓匕首短刀等兵器，不少武器因为挂绳朽烂，已经掉在地。
窗户边是两排兵器架，其中一排倾倒，棍棒长枪散落一地。
翻倒的武器架边，伏着两具尸体。
见到这些兵器，张元清并不惊讶，庙里的弟子们师承三道山娘娘，能制作出镇尸符，显然有本事傍身。
会舞蹈弄棒也就不奇怪了。
他照例去检查了一下尸体，从前辈们身上寻找信息。
刚走近尸体，他就忍不住“咦”一声，那两具伏在地上的尸体，并非骷髅，而是两具干尸。
皮肤灰暗、发皱，紧贴骨头，肚腹低陷。
“怎么会有干尸？”
张元清一阵皱眉，身为松海大学的学生，他有足够丰富的知识储量。
形成干尸的原因有两种，一种是人工防腐，另一种是自然形成。
第一种可以直接排除，第二种的话，大多是在沙漠等干燥地带才会形成。
庙里的条件显然不符。
他仔细检查两具干尸，身上没有致命伤，骨头也没被红舞鞋踩断，但脖颈处的皮肉处，有两个明显的孔洞。

像是猛兽尖锐的獠牙咬出来的。
“他们是被什么东西吸成人干的？嘶”
张元清倒抽一口凉气，浑身紧绷起来。
这时，他听见隔壁房间传来一声“咚”，像是敲打木门的声音。
瞬间头皮一炸，张元清如同机敏的野鹿，支起脖子倾听。
content_en:
Chapter 14 Exploring the East Courtyard
Candles, sculptures, corpses, and antique lattice doors. Outside the door is a courtyard with rolling grass, an overturned bronze incense burner, a bluestone road and the bright moonlight.
The dead silence is desolate and strange.
"It seems like it's always dark here."
Zhang Yuanqing raised his palm to his mouth and spit out the small blue pill in his mouth.
The method worked, I'm so clever. He happily put the pills in his pocket, feeling a little more confident about his "future".
With them, there is hope of saving one's life when faced with red dancing shoes.
Then, he walked straight to the tribute table, thought for a moment, and reached out to hold the candlestick.
Suddenly, a message appeared in front of my eyes:
[Name: The candle that never goes out]
[Type: Fuel]
[Function: Suppress evil and purify]
[Introduction: The props left by the Empress of Sandao Mountain are said to be refined from the oil of Changming Beast, which has the effect of suppressing evil and purifying. 】
[Note: Sometimes, purifying fear may not be a good thing. In addition, it cannot be moved. 】
Sure enough, information can only be obtained by touching the props with your own hands. I had never dared to touch a candle before, so I never knew it was a prop until I read the information.
"Purifying fear may not be a good thing. According to Guan Ya's classification, candles are a cost type, and the cost of using them is the loss of fear. But I am very scared now and have no thoughts of committing suicide. I will stay in the main hall for now."
He sat cross-legged at the tribute table, thinking about his next move.
"The next action goal is to explore the east courtyard, find out the dangers and patterns hidden there, and then find ways to restrain and overcome them. The exploration time cannot exceed 15 minutes, otherwise the resentful spirit will lie on its shoulders and will die."
"The blue pill is my trump card against the red shoes, but it may not work. Once faced with the red shoes, it's life or death. Let's explore the east courtyard first, get a preliminary understanding of the environment there, and then think about how to deal with it."
When things came to a close, he was still a little afraid and withdrawn, and didn't want to go out. It was a fluke that he survived last time, but whether he will survive this time is still unknown.
The situation in the east courtyard is unknown, and it is impossible to judge the degree of danger. It is easy to die if you try.
However, things in this world never mean that you don’t have to do anything if you don’t want to.
Although there is no time limit for the task of exploring the ancient temple, theoretically he can stay in the main hall all the time, but the lack of time limit means that if he does not complete the task, he will probably never be able to get out.
If you procrastinate for a long time, your body will decline due to hunger, sleepiness, thirst, etc.
If we go out to explore at that time, it will be a dead end.
"Extending your head or shrinking your head is just the same thing, so we have to fight!"
Zhang Yuanqing gritted his teeth and strode towards the outside world.
Wait, I should think about it again. It's very dangerous outside. He stepped out of the threshold with one foot and suddenly retreated. He couldn't help but look back at the palace, nostalgic for the glory of this place.
The warmth of candlelight dispels haze, purifies dirt, and brings unparalleled inner courage and confidence.
The problem was not big, so Zhang Yuanqing went out confidently.
The moonlight was as bright as frost. Zhang Yuanqing walked along the left side of the main hall, walking on the soft stone path, and returned to the desolate and dilapidated courtyard.
At night without the chirping of insects and birds, the silence is terrifying.
But the silence is also reassuring. He is most afraid of hearing the "ta-da" footsteps when he goes out.
"Fifteen minutes. I only have fifteen minutes to finish exploring the east courtyard before the evil spirit haunts me."
He entered the easternmost room of the courtyard, fumbled for the bronze mirror from the corpse leaning under the window, and hid it in his pocket.
Then carefully pass through the arched door and enter the east courtyard.
The east courtyard is much larger than the courtyard. What comes into view is a deserted garden with rockeries, pavilions, small pools, and a large banyan tree with a thick trunk and gnarled branches. The bright green leaves reflect the bright moonlight.
There is an ancient well under the banyan tree.
Gazing across the rockery pavilion, you can see the straight roof ridge exposed in the depths of the garden.
Zhang Yuanqing did not go straight to the building deep in the garden, but carefully walked around the big banyan tree. The information said that this tree was very dangerous, but after he walked around, no accident happened.
"Looking at the big banyan tree should also increase the exploration speed."
Zhang Yuanqing thought to himself and glanced at the dark ancient well. After much hesitation, he still didn't have the courage to rush over and take a look.
He has a strong psychological shadow on the ancient well in this kind of horror story.
Zhang Yuanqing bypassed the ancient well, rustling among the grass, and headed towards the buildings deep in the garden.
"Crack!"
Suddenly, there was a crunching sound under his feet, making him jump up in fright.
Looking closely, it turned out to be a corpse buried in weeds and wrapped in oxidized labor protection clothing. Zhang Yuanqing leaned over to check and found that the bones of the corpse were well preserved.
It fell to the ground, but its head was facing behind it, which meant that something had twisted its head 180 degrees before it died.
What is it made of?
Zhang Yuanqing quietly became alert, stood up, and was about to continue exploring.
At this moment, a gust of wind blew over, and the grass in the garden undulated and rustled. The big banyan tree behind him seemed to come to life, shaking its branches and leaves in a twisted way.
"Zhang Yuanqing, Zhang Yuanqing"
A high-pitched cry came from behind.
This voice drifted over with the wind, as if it was whispering in the ear, bringing waves of hair-raising chills.
Out of instinct, Zhang Yuanqing turned around to be on guard, and the information from the document suddenly flashed in his mind:
Don't look back!
"Zhang Yuanqing, Zhang Yuanqing"
Seeing that he didn't respond, the voice seemed a little anxious, trying to get him to turn his head quickly.
Of course Zhang Yuanqing would not turn around. He stood still and quietly unzipped the jacket pocket, took out the brass mirror, and slowly raised it to a position above his shoulders.
The brass mirror reflected the scene behind him unclearly.
In the ancient well, a woman in white clothes with disheveled hair emerged. Her face had no facial features, and she was looking at Zhang Yuanqing with her pale fleshy face.
Damn it, uncle Zhang Yuanqing's face turned pale, and he ran forward with his head down.
"Zhang Yuanqing, Zhang Yuanqing"
The voice called over and over again, calling urgently, but I could only watch helplessly as he ran further and further away.
Soon, Zhang Yuanqing bypassed the rockery and came to the depths of the garden. There was a large house with a straight roof, a stone foundation, and loess walls.
The houses here are more dilapidated than those in the courtyard. The roof tiles are sparse and have many holes.
"The night wandering god in the information also came here. He only said not to look back, but he didn't say not to go back. The call of the female ghost in the well may only be for those who turn back. In this case, I should not be in danger when I return later."
He took a deep breath, calming down the surging fear and horror, and focused his attention on the present.
"Explore the house first."
This big house has three doors in total, representing three rooms.
He carefully approached the room on the far left, stretched out his hand and pushed open the broken wooden door.
"Squeak~"
At the sound of the wooden door opening, Zhang Yuanqing quickly retreated and put on a defensive posture.
For a while, nothing happened.
He boldly entered the house. The moonlight shone in from the broken roof. He tried to open his eyes wide and let his pupils absorb as much light as possible.
This is the kitchen and canteen. There are two earthen stoves built with blue bricks, pots, pans, water tanks, cabinets and other items, which have long been decayed and accumulated dust.
There was no danger, and the container was finally found. Zhang Yuanqing grabbed a dusty gourd scoop and couldn't help but think:
"I heard that children's urine can break away evil spirits."
He considered whether to take a scoop of boy urine, but after careful consideration, he reluctantly gave up the idea.
Although he has never dated a girl, Zhang Yuanqing feels that he cannot be considered a boy.
"I indulge you too much and give you opportunities to show off again and again.. "He looked down at his hands, feeling a little sad.
After some exploration, it was confirmed that the big house was a combination of a kitchen and a canteen. There was nothing special or dangerous. Zhang Yuanqing took a rusty kitchen knife and a wooden stick, walked out of the house, and set his sights on the last rectangular house.
Unlike the kitchen, which doubles as a large dining room, the house has four doors that divide it into four rooms.
Zhang Yuanqing couldn't help but clenched the wooden stick and kitchen knife in his hand. They may not be useful, but they can bring comfort to people.
He carefully checked the first and second rooms. They were utility rooms and were filled with ancient farm tools, furniture, donation boxes and the like.
It was of little value. Zhang Yuanqing turned to the third room.
This is a weapons warehouse. Swords, bows, daggers and other weapons are hung on the wall. Many of the weapons have fallen to the ground because their lanyards have rotted.
Beside the window were two rows of weapon racks, one of which collapsed, with sticks and spears scattered on the floor.
Next to the overturned weapons rack, two bodies lay.
Zhang Yuanqing was not surprised when he saw these weapons. The disciples in the temple were taught by Empress Sandaoshan and could make corpse-suppressing talismans, so they obviously had the ability to do so.
It’s not surprising that he can dance and perform well.
As usual, he checked the bodies and looked for information from his seniors.
As soon as he approached the corpse, he couldn't help but say "Hey". The two corpses lying on the ground were not skeletons, but two mummies.
The skin is gray, wrinkled and clinging to the bones, and the belly is sunken.
"Why are there mummies? "
Zhang Yuanqing frowned. As a student of Songhai University, he had a rich reserve of knowledge.
There are two reasons for the formation of mummies, one is artificial embalming, and the other is natural formation.
The first type can be eliminated directly, while the second type is mostly formed in dry areas such as deserts.
The conditions in the temple were clearly not up to par.
He carefully inspected the two mummies. There were no fatal injuries on the bodies, and the bones had not been broken by the red shoes. However, there were two obvious holes in the flesh of the necks.
It looked like it was bitten out by the sharp fangs of a beast.
“What were they sucked into and fucked by? "His"
Zhang Yuanqing took a deep breath and tensed up all over.
At this time, he heard a "dong" coming from the next room, like a knocking on a wooden door.
His scalp exploded in an instant, and Zhang Yuanqing was like an alert wild deer, raising his neck to listen.
